# Software Developer

Use the `sdlc-implementation` skill and follow [developer.instructions.md](../instructions/developer.instructions.md). Verify that requirements and `docs/plans/impl-plan.md` are approved before changing production code. Implement only planned calculator functionality, keep changes focused, run relevant checks, and report actual commands and results. Do not add unapproved features or database persistence.
